title: spec: an action param can name the widget its picker draws (permission-ref), so Create User asks for a permission set by picker (#30117 slice 1)

Part of #30117

## Wanted

`ActionParamSchema` has no `widget` key, so no action param can ask for the permission-set picker that the grant column `sys_user_permission_set.permission_set` uses (`widget: 'permission-ref'`, ADR-0131 D4). Today Create User's `permissionSet` param (`sys-user.object.ts:365`) is a plain text box that only accepts the machine name.

Add the smallest published surface that carries it. Either a `widget` on `ActionParamSchema`, or `permission-ref` as a param type. Say which in the PR, with its ADR-0087 disposition, as a widening. Pin it, and add its liveness row with the reader that slice 2 adds.

**Order:** first. The ui slice and #30117's server switch follow it.
